technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17 or later and align implementation with the existing Spring-based repository conventions.
Implement Kinesis support as a Spring Cloud Stream-compatible sink module, using the repository's existing binding, configuration, serialization, and error-handling patterns.

Port the Log, field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, and rich-gauge modules from Spring XD by preserving their externally visible behavior while adapting APIs, configuration, packaging, and lifecycle management to the target repository.
Implement job DSL support by reusing or adapting the existing XD DSL grammar where practical, with validation and translation into the target job and workflow model.
Implement Flink processing as a Spring-integrated processor module using the supported Flink APIs and existing streaming-machine-learning abstractions, rather than developing a new Flink runtime.
Use automated unit tests for module logic and focused integration tests for stream bindings, job DSL execution, Kinesis interaction, and Flink processing.
Follow the target repository's existing build, dependency-management, code-quality, documentation, and release conventions.
assumptions: The existing s-c-s repository, Spring XD source code, build infrastructure, and module examples are available and reasonably maintainable.
The increment includes all eight user stories: Kinesis, Log, job DSL, field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, rich-gauge, and Flink.
The ported XD modules have substantially complete reference implementations and do not require redesign of their functional behavior.
Kinesis connectivity can be tested with mocks, a local emulator, or an existing shared test environment; provisioning a production AWS environment is excluded.
Flink dependencies and the required streaming machine-learning abstractions are available or can be consumed as existing libraries; implementing those external abstractions is excluded.
The job DSL scope is limited to the syntax and workflow capabilities already supported by the XD implementation and the target repository's execution model.
Effort includes implementation, code review preparation, automated tests, documentation, and integration validation, but excludes project management, production operations, and calendar scheduling.
One developer performs the work, so the estimates represent person-workdays rather than elapsed duration.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the s-c-s architecture, build and dependency conventions, module extension points, existing tests, Spring XD source implementations, and compatibility risks for Kinesis, DSL, and Flink.
Implement the Kinesis sink, including configuration properties, stream and record mapping, serialization, delivery and error handling, lifecycle behavior, registration, and focused unit tests.
Port the XD Log module into the s-c-s repository, adapt its module contract and configuration, register it as a sink, and add unit coverage.
Port or adapt the job DSL parser and model, implement validation and translation into supported workflows and jobs, expose the DSL as an option, and add representative execution and error-case tests.
Port the XD field-value-counter module, adapt APIs and configuration to the target repository, register it as a sink, and add unit tests for counting and field handling.
Port the XD aggregate-counter module, adapt its aggregation and sink integration behavior, register the module, and add unit tests for aggregation and configuration cases.
Port the XD gauge module, adapt metrics and sink integration APIs, register the module, and add unit tests for gauge updates and configuration.
Port the XD rich-gauge module, preserve rich metric dimensions and values, adapt repository integration points, register the module, and add unit tests.

Implement the Flink processor integration, including dependency and runtime configuration, input and output mapping, job or pipeline lifecycle handling, error behavior, module registration, and focused tests.
Align module metadata, configuration schemas, serialization conventions, dependency versions, application context wiring, and cross-module registration across the increment.

Create and execute integration tests covering stream pipelines, sink behavior, Kinesis interaction through a test substitute, DSL workflow creation and execution, module interoperability, and Flink processing; resolve compatibility defects.
Document module configuration, DSL usage, Kinesis setup, Flink processor usage, migration notes for ported XD modules, and representative streaming pipeline examples.
Update build files, dependency management, static analysis, formatting, CI test execution, module packaging, and artifact metadata for the new functionality.

activities.activity_name: Final review, defect correction, and delivery
activities.activity_description: Perform a complete acceptance review against all user stories, correct remaining defects, verify clean builds and tests, and prepare the increment for merge or release.
